title: When Users Don't Ask: Benchmarking Context-Driven Memory Retrieval in Conversational Agents
mechanism: Add a multi-facet query-rewriting pre-step in recall_gateway that expands implicit/composed queries into 2-4 explicit sub-queries before RRF merge, targeting the retrieval gap the paper shows on implicit/composed conversational queries

expected_gain.metric: recall nDCG@20 on implicit/composed query subset
expected_gain.rationale: chitta's hybrid RRF already merges semantic+typed+spreading+session lanes and reranks, but has no query-rewriting stage, so implicit/composed queries (paper's main gap) aren't reformulated before lane dispatch

evidence.claim: paper finds conversational framing exposes retrieval gaps especially on implicit and composed queries
multi-facet query rewriting narrows the gap for raw-turn memory but not abstractive memory
strong retrieval does not fully translate into response quality (silent grounding on implicit queries)
